description: An \(L(M)\)-structure \(N^*\) satisfies \(\operatorname{Diag}(M)\) if and only if the specific map \(a\mapsto c_a^{N^*}\) is the underlying map of an embedding from \(M\) into the \(L\)-reduct of \(N^*\).
signature:

  [(L.lhomWithConstants M).IsExpansionOn N] :
  N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.signedDiagram L M ↔
    ∃ e, ⇑e = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.canonicalMap L M N
